arc.title: A Idade das Escolhas
arc.description: Um ano de estudo e cartas leva Ilyan e Runa até a Ponte das Faias e às próprias escolhas.

pages.title: A mão e a lâmina
pages.scene: Infirmary wraps Ilyan's RIGHT wrist, then east forge master Teren examines one nick on Ilyan's blunt training sword.

lines.speaker: Teren
lines.text: A lâmina aguenta depois do reparo.

pages.title: Dois protocolos
pages.scene: Ordelia files flood testimony and Mira inquiry in two separate folders at the same tall archive desk; Runa carries Braka's measurement.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Enchente aqui. Mira, em outra pasta.

pages.title: Uma frase riscada
pages.scene: Adra returns their river report with a sentence treating Pedra-Verde as a mere observation point crossed out; Ilyan rewrites to name Braka's decision.

pages.title: A escala errada
pages.scene: In measuring classroom Runa finds a scale mismatch with Vessa's water readings and redraws the graph while Ilyan caps ink and steadies lamp.

pages.title: Turnos comuns
pages.scene: Wide school library after long work shift; Ilyan copies records using healed but still stiff right hand and Runa puts covers over open ink jars.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Não transforme cada noite em punição.

pages.title: O preço da lenha
pages.scene: At school refectory Tovo tallies kitchen fuel, learners count weekly dues, Ilyan and Runa share ordinary supper.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: A lenha subiu. O pão, não.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Então dividimos o turno de cópia.

pages.title: Ficar entre
pages.scene: Sere stages safe retreat training on wet stones; Ilyan first rushes too far, then shields a retreating student; Caio asks to repeat drill.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Proteja a saída, não a sua pressa.

pages.title: A resposta de Vessa
pages.scene: A sealed ordinary letter from Vessa reaches archive; Runa checks eight-tooth float measurements and Ilyan compares them with the earlier report.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A causa do corte ainda falta.

pages.title: Assinaturas
pages.scene: Ilyan and Runa present revised flood report with separate approvals from three communities, including Adra's, to Ordelia; document chain remains visible.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Então posso abrir a consulta pública.

pages.title: A carta com lama
pages.scene: West bridge community letter arrives with dried mud; Ordelia reads no confirmed sighting of Mira this year, only an older unnamed woman with surveying instruments.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: O registro antigo ainda merece data.

pages.title: Três datas
pages.scene: Ilyan and Runa align three mismatched dates on desk, no magical revelation; Ilyan struggles with uncertainty, Runa keeps records separate.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Temos três datas. Comecemos por elas.

pages.title: A água no aro
pages.scene: Runa trains Caio to hold a thin ring of existing water in a copper hoop; Ilyan waits without interrupting, holding the bridge letters.

pages.title: Ao escrivão vivo
pages.scene: Ilyan and Runa write a precise dated question to living west-bridge scribe, seal letter for courier, not a sudden journey.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Vou perguntar o que ele realmente viu.

pages.title: O inverno cobra
pages.scene: Cold season in school map classroom: covered windows, costly wood, Ordelia insists on removing cloth by day to prevent mold; Ilyan carries modest fuel.

pages.title: Botas de argila
pages.scene: New scribe letter in spring says unnamed woman had clay-covered boots and compass case; Ilyan marks possible evidence without calling her Mira.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Caixa de compassos. Botas de argila.

pages.title: A ponte volta aos poucos
pages.scene: Time passage shown by repaired western bridge: Beren supervises pedestrians first, one cart at a time later; Adra checks public passage and village folk work.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: Primeiro a pé. Depois uma carroça.

pages.title: Volta curta à forja
pages.scene: Ilyan arrives in Pedra-Mansa by ordinary hired cart after permitted trip, meets ADULT small gnome Nima at Bram's forge, friend rather than romantic embrace; Bram handles metal.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Você voltou com a mão inteira?

pages.title: De novo à Casa
pages.scene: Ilyan returns to the school gate by road after short visit; Runa waits with revised measures; they disagree about one calculation then solve it side by side.

pages.title: Dezoito velas desiguais
pages.scene: After a clearly shown year of ordinary study and seasons, Runa turns 18; Tovo offers small bread, Caio places four mismatched candles, Ilyan gives straightened copper ruler.

pages.title: Um obrigado quieto
pages.scene: Later alone after Runa's 18th birthday, she checks the handmade copper ruler then leans forehead briefly onto Ilyan's shoulder while they close instrument boxes; not a kiss.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Você perdeu sono por esta régua?

pages.title: A luva de Bram
pages.scene: Ilyan turns 18; courier gifts from Bram and Nima, right hand recovered; Teren presents repaired blunt sword at east forge; Runa notices old marks on grip.

lines.speaker: Teren
lines.text: O fio continua cego. A arma, firme.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Seu pai mediu a luva pelos seus dedos.

pages.title: A carta que demora
pages.scene: At Pedra-Mansa forge ADULT gnome Nima privately begins a letter after hearing Ilyan and Runa work together; three nights pass through candle states while Bram rests with a cold; no child or jealous caricature.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Não é culpa dela eu sentir falta dele.

pages.title: A verdade de Nima
pages.scene: Adult gnome Nima writes a sincere present-day confession to Ilyan, then seals it for ordinary four-day courier; mechanical tools on workbench.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Talvez isso mude nossa amizade. Ele precisa saber.

pages.title: Quatro dias de estrada
pages.scene: Courier places Nima letter in Ilyan's hand after defense class, dusty boots and repaired blunt sword; Ilyan reads alone under an arch, no Nima physically in school.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ela nunca disse que sentia isso.

pages.title: Sopa fria
pages.scene: Runa finds Ilyan absentminded over cold soup in empty refectory; he tells her about Nima's adult confession without making Runa a prize.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Uma verdade que não sei responder.

pages.title: Três rascunhos
pages.scene: Ilyan alone at his cedar dorm desk writes and crosses out three drafts, finally tells Nima he loves her as friend but cannot promise romance.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Não vou oferecer esperança que não tenho.

pages.title: O envio
pages.scene: Ilyan seals honest reply and hands it to school courier registrar Ordelia; outgoing mail pouch marked for Pedra-Mansa, ordinary travel.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Esta sai com a caravana da manhã.

pages.title: O livro do pedágio
pages.scene: Ilyan and Runa check west bridge toll ledger; a column of names was covered with later ink, they record altered state instead of inferring missing identity.

pages.title: Pão e silêncio
pages.scene: Tovo brings forgotten bread to tired Ilyan and discusses the ingenious adult gnome from Pedra-Mansa as a real friend, no romantic pressure.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Era a Nima que consertava trincos?

pages.title: Seis dias depois
pages.scene: After six days ordinary caravan, adult gnome Nima reads Ilyan's refusal at her workbench, hurt but dignified; Bram nearby does not intrude.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Doía menos não saber. Mas era uma mentira.

pages.title: Tempo pedido
pages.scene: After Nima's short reply asking time, Ilyan tells Runa at measuring classroom; Runa respects Nima and does not force intimacy.

pages.title: A folga antiga
pages.scene: Letter signed by Braka with Vessa's observation arrives; eight-tooth float could explain older water discrepancy, not the cut bell rope.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A folga explica parte da medida.

pages.title: Dois mapas
pages.scene: Runa sets separate blank sheets for west course and personal letters; Ilyan mistakenly mixes marks then corrects with her, closeness grows through work.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Uma folha para a água. Outra para as cartas.

pages.title: A seta tardia
pages.scene: Ordelia reveals later south-pointing arrow and covered depth number in original west bridge ledger; preservation of evidence, no magical map.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A seta é posterior ao registro.

pages.title: A oferta dos Diques
pages.scene: Líria approaches Runa in school instrument corridor with legitimate offer from School of Dikes but restricted publication; rival has two tight braids, chin scar.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Há uma vaga. Exigem a planta aprovada.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: E as pessoas que moram fora dela?

pages.title: Terra de três margens
pages.scene: Gnomic master Oru asks Runa and Líria to predict water passage through three soil samples; Runa observes accurate grain and avoids theatrical magic, Líria contributes.

pages.title: Admiração sem troféu
pages.scene: Ilyan watches Runa's precise soil demonstration from classroom doorway with carry crate, admires skill; she says it was measurement, not defeating Líria.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Você viu a falha antes de todos.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Vi porque Líria mostrou a borda.

pages.title: A proposta de Maelor
pages.scene: Maelor's envoy delivers document to Eda, offering bridge repair money for survey priority; Maelor himself not physically there, only copper square seal on letter.

pages.title: Uma proposta aberta
pages.scene: Night in school measure room: Runa writes alternative with community coauthors, travel expenses and public correction; Ilyan steadies lamp and offers tea.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Sem as margens, a proposta é incompleta.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Eu fico para ajudar nas contas.

pages.title: A assinatura de Líria
pages.scene: Líria sees a village that aided her family named in Runa's alternative, notes soil-grain error and signs as technical coauthor; sanction remains.

pages.title: A recusa
pages.scene: School of Dikes written refusal arrives: scholarship only for approved map excluding community authors; Runa reads, disappointed, Ordelia waits.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A decisão deles não encerra seu trabalho.

pages.title: O mapa do pai
pages.scene: Runa tells Ilyan about her father making maps without visiting families; she refuses shortcut despite loss, Ilyan listens on school hill at dusk.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Eu não repetirei o erro dele.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Eu fico para ouvir o preço disso.

pages.title: Ensaio aprovado
pages.scene: School council approves smaller public community study after west bridge inspection, with invited observers; Runa holds authorization, Ilyan safeguards copies.

pages.title: Três respostas
pages.scene: Adra ferries team west carrying three distinct community responses to Maelor contract; everyone boards physical ferry, no portal.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Duas pedem mudanças. Uma rejeita a prioridade.

pages.title: A água escurece
pages.scene: Midriver ferry: Adra and barqueiro point out dark water over shifting sandbank absent from Dikes map; Runa measures without inventing certainty.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Vou marcar o lugar, não a causa.

pages.title: A cláusula pequena
pages.scene: At Faias inn Ilyan reads Maelor contract clause permitting preliminary map without all testimonies; Runa sees why consent matters.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ele pode publicar antes de ouvir todos.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Então amanhã levamos a cláusula ao conselho.

pages.title: A ponte de pilares
pages.scene: Independent mason Beren tests repaired western bridge supports while local council opens toll book; Ilyan carries tools, Runa notes levels, no heroic shortcut.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: Uma tábua firme não prova a fundação.

pages.title: Oferta exclusiva
pages.scene: Valecobre merchant offers sole survey payment to bridge council; Ilyan and Runa observe members refusing signature before public reading, merchant not given arbitrary villain identity.

pages.title: A assembleia
pages.scene: Village assembly hears Beren's safety limits and reads toll ledger; repair stays incomplete for carts, public access decisions are theirs.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: O mapa precisa mostrar esse limite.

pages.title: Uma conversa adiada
pages.scene: In borrowed lodging Ilyan helps Runa untie instrument case with blunt knife, their fingers touch; they explicitly discuss Nima's letter without using romance as consolation.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Não quero ser resposta à dor dela.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: O que sinto por você veio de muitos dias.

pages.title: Dois dias de retorno
pages.scene: Two-day ordinary caravan road from west bridge toward Valecobre in fine rain, one evening campfire with Runa and Ilyan discussing freedom and fear; no teleport.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Tenho medo de escolher e perder minha voz.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Eu temo confundir cuidado com controle.

pages.title: A altura da estrela
pages.scene: School observatory with four thick-glass windows above map wing; Avel supervises star-level measurement, signs notebook and leaves carrying box; Ilyan keeps lamp away from lenses.

lines.speaker: Mestra Avel
lines.text: Registrem a correção e fechem as quatro janelas.

pages.title: O primeiro beijo
pages.scene: After Avel leaves, rain on west observatory glass, Ilyan asks Runa directly if she wants him to kiss her; she consents and steps toward him, then they share FIRST intense tender kiss as two adults over 18, fully clothed, precise identities.

pages.title: O dia seguinte
pages.scene: Next morning school dining hall: Ilyan smiles into tea, Caio asks about sword, Runa corrects his map calculation; later a west bridge letter arrives with square copper seal hinting at Maelor but not proof.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Esta curva ainda precisa de revisão.
